title: Regularization and algebraic stability of birational automorphisms
summary: We compare five natural classes of birational automorphisms of an algebraic variety: projectively regularizable, regularizable, projectively pseudo-regularizable, pseudo-regularizable, and those admitting an algebraically stable model. These classes provide different geometric frameworks in which the dynamics of a birational automorphism, and in particular its first dynamical degree, can be studied.
